clubs.name: CodeCell
clubs.tagline: The campus programming club, open to every branch and every level.
clubs.about:
CodeCell runs the weekly problem-solving room, peer code reviews and the occasional 2am build sprint. Members work in whatever language they like; the point is shipping something and explaining how it works.

We keep a shared shelf of lab kits and a standing invitation to first-years. No prior competitive programming background is expected, only a willingness to break your own code and read the error message.

clubs.name: Torque Robotics
clubs.tagline: Motors, sensors and stubborn hardware that eventually behaves.
clubs.about:
Torque is the robotics club, working out of the Block D lab with a modest but well-used set of drivers, boards and a very patient 3D printer. Teams build line followers, small rovers and the occasional useless-but-delightful machine.

We meet twice a week during build season. Beginners are paired with a senior member for their first soldering job, and every project ends with a demo night where things are allowed to fail loudly.

clubs.name: Raag & Rhythm
clubs.tagline: A music room with an open door and a slightly out-of-tune piano.
clubs.about:
Raag & Rhythm is the campus music club: film songs, Hindustani classical, and whatever the members are listening to that month. Rehearsals happen in the amphitheatre annexe, and the club keeps a small inventory of amps, stands and one very reliable tabla set.

Auditions are informal and mostly about finding a good section fit. Members form ad-hoc bands for festivals, play at open mics, and run a listening circle once a month where nobody has to perform.

clubs.name: Footwork Collective
clubs.tagline: Street, contemporary and classical dance, all on the same scuffed floor.
clubs.about:
Footwork is a choreography collective rather than a single style crew. Members bring pieces in hip-hop, contemporary and Bharatanatyam, and the annual showcase mixes them deliberately.

The studio in the student centre is booked on weekday evenings. Practice is open to anyone who shows up consistently, and the club runs a beginner batch each semester for people who have never danced on a stage before.

clubs.name: Baseline Club
clubs.tagline: Courts, tracks and early mornings, with better company than an alarm clock.
clubs.about:
Baseline looks after casual and competitive sport outside the official teams: badminton ladders, weekend runs, and pickup games on the outdoor courts. Everything is organised by students who just wanted someone to play with.

There is no selection trial. The club keeps a few spare racquets and shuttlecocks for newcomers, and the Sunday runs have a slower group so nobody gets left behind on the first kilometre.

clubs.name: Kadam Collective
clubs.tagline: Small, regular work in the neighbourhood around the campus.
clubs.about:
Kadam coordinates volunteering that fits around a student timetable: weekend teaching sessions, donation drives and clean-up mornings with the local residents' association. The club picks a few commitments and sticks with them rather than running one-off photo opportunities.

Members sign up for a shift at a time, and travel is arranged in groups from the main gate. There is a short orientation before the first shift and no minimum hours for the semester.

clubs.name: Praxis Debate Society
clubs.tagline: Argument as a craft, practised weekly and in good faith.
clubs.about:
Praxis runs parliamentary debate and public speaking sessions, with a focus on reasoning that survives contact with an opponent. The society fields teams for inter-college tournaments and hosts a monthly open debate on campus.

New members start in the novice bracket, where a senior member walks through structure, rebuttal and speaking drills. No prior tournament experience is needed, and the club keeps a small library of case files and past motions.

clubs.name: Frame Rate
clubs.tagline: The campus photography and film crew, from darkroom basics to final cuts.
clubs.about:
Frame Rate covers photography and short film: camera handling, lighting, editing and the unglamorous work of organising footage. The club borrows out a small kit of bodies and lenses to members who have completed the handling session.

Members shoot campus events, produce an end-of-semester zine, and run critique nights where work is discussed plainly and without flattery. Phone cameras are welcome; the composition matters more than the sensor.

events.title: Winter Build Sprint
events.description: A one-day sprint for small teams: pick a prompt at 10, ship something by 17:30, demo to the room. Mentors float between tables, and lunch is on the club.

events.title: November Unplugged
events.description: An acoustic evening with six short sets from club members and two guest slots from the hostel floors. Bring a blanket; the amphitheatre gets cold after sunset.

events.title: Sunday Court Runs
events.description: Casual badminton and a 3km loop for anyone who prefers the track. Two pace groups for the run and spare racquets at the desk.

events.title: Arguing With Strangers
events.description: A session on disagreeing well: how to steelman a position you dislike and still land a rebuttal. Includes a live cross-examination exercise with the audience.

events.title: Motor Driver Basics
events.description: Wiring, PWM and the small mistakes that release the magic smoke. Participants leave with a working driver board and a written pinout they can reuse.

events.title: Floorcraft Session
events.description: An open practice with three short combos taught in the first hour and free floor time after. Beginner friendly, shoes indoors only.

events.title: Mock Technical Interviews
events.description: Twenty-minute mock interviews with a senior member, followed by written feedback on structure and clarity. Sign-up required; slots are allocated in order.

events.title: Night Walk Photo Meetup
events.description: A slow walk through the lit parts of campus with a focus on long exposure and hand-held low light. Tripods available to borrow, phones welcome.

events.title: Winter Donation Drive
events.description: Sorting and packing donated warm clothing with the residents' association. Two-hour shifts; drop in for whichever slot suits you.

events.title: Manual Mode Bootcamp
events.description: A full day off auto: aperture, shutter, ISO and metering, with shooting exercises in the quad after lunch. A camera with manual controls is required; loaners are limited.

events.title: Inter-Department Badminton
events.description: Mixed doubles knockout across departments, best of three to 21. Register a pair; departmental jerseys optional but encouraged.

events.title: Building a Rover That Survives
events.description: A walk through the club's last rover build: chassis choices, power budgeting, and the failure modes that only showed up on rough ground. Followed by an open Q&A and a bench demo.

events.title: Civic Hack Day
events.description: Teams of three to five work on small tools for local needs, from bus timetables to clinic queues. Problem statements are shared a week ahead; judging is by the community partners.

events.title: Showcase Auditions
events.description: Auditions for the annual showcase, open to solos, duets and group pieces in any style. Bring your own track on a pen drive; slots are fifteen minutes.
